sentences: Something Like Love is a 1968 Italian drama film directed by Enzo Muzii.
It was entered into the 18th Berlin International Film Festival where it won the Silver Bear Extraordinary Prize of the Jury.

This Year's Blonde is a 1980 American made- for- TV docudrama film directed by John Erman and starring Constance Forslund as 1950s sex symbol Marilyn Monroe, Lloyd Bridges as Johnny Hyde, and Norman Fell.
Based on the Garson Kanin novel" Moviola" about Monroe, the film was presented as part of a 3- night TV special event on NBC called" Moviola: A Hollywood Saga".
" This Year's Blonde" was the first of two TV movies about Monroe in 1980, the second being, starring Catherine Hicks.
Enzo Muzii( 13 January 1926 – 2 February 2014) was an Italian film director, writer and photographer.
In 1968 he won the Jury Grand Prix at the Berlin International Film Festival for his film" Something Like Love".
